node: Power transformers, switchgear, substations, and grid-interconnection equipment
summary: Expanded the universe around U.S. AI/data-center power-infrastructure chokepoints using a two-lane funnel. Reference lane: larger electrical-equipment names validating demand in switchgear, bus systems, utility T&D and data-center electrical infrastructure. Underfollowed lane: more focused or less-obvious public companies tied to custom medium-voltage switchgear, grid-line/substation hardware, and microgrid/mobile-power alternatives. The strongest direct evidence in this pass is Powell Industries' record backlog and explicit mega data-center orders; the best underfollowed second-order evidence is Preformed Line Products' grid/network construction exposure. Pioneer Power is included only as a micro-cap speculative-shadow candidate because its relevance is plausible but requires much stronger order/backlog verification.
